# GenZ Editor

> A free, private, browser-based editor for almost any file type. Open, edit, and
> export files, code, images, documents, sketches, and even playable games —
> entirely in your browser. No account required, no uploads to a server for basic
> editing, and no limits for everyday use.

## What it is

GenZ Editor (https://genzeditor.com) is a client-side web application. Files are
stored locally in the browser (OPFS) and never leave your device unless you
explicitly create a share link. It is built on Cloudflare Workers/Pages.

## Key capabilities

- Text, Markdown, JSON, and code editing with syntax awareness.
- Image editing (crop, filters, background removal) and format conversion.
- Document and PDF viewing/editing.
- Diagrams and sketches (Excalidraw-style whiteboard, floor plans, 3D view).
- Audio/video processing and export (ffmpeg in the browser).
- A collaborative Game Builder for live co-building and playing games.
- Shareable links: read-only snapshots or editable (save-back) links.

## Privacy

- Local-first: editing happens on-device; files live in browser storage.
- Sharing is opt-in and uses expiring, revocable links.
- Sign-in (email one-time code, Google, or GitHub) is optional and only needed
  for editable share links and higher limits.
